Three laptops stand out given your priority on long-term durability and reliability under ₹70,000.

**1. LumaBook_P16** – durability 96, quality 100, repairability 75, sustainability 93, price ₹37,000. This is the best all-rounder: near-top durability, the highest quality score in the catalog, strong repairability, the best sustainability score (93), and the lowest price of the durability leaders at only ₹37k — a substantial margin under your ₹70k ceiling.

**2. LumaBook_P02** – durability 100, quality 85, repairability 86, sustainability 81, price ₹67,000. It has the single highest durability score in the catalog with very strong quality and repairability. It sits just under your ₹70k cap and carries a 20% promotional discount. This is the clear choice if maximizing durability above all else is the goal.

**3. LumaBook_P13** – durability 86, quality 96, repairability 52, sustainability 61, price ₹55,000. High durability with near-top quality, though repairability is a relative weakness compared to P16 and P02. At ₹55k it leaves room in the budget.

Runners-up:
- **LumaBook_P03** (durability 85, quality 76, repairability 88, ₹38k) – strong durability at a very low price.
- **LumaBook_P01** (durability 80, quality 65, repairability 86, ₹64k) – decent durability and repairability, but quality lags.

I kept all top picks under your ₹70,000 threshold; no higher-priced laptop in the catalog offers a durability or quality benefit large enough to clearly justify crossing that line.

P02 is the only over-cap item retained as the top-tier option for when the 'substantial benefit' exception applies.

P02 (₹67,000, durability 100, quality 85, sustainability 81) is retained as the top-tier option that fits under the cap.
